result.requestedCompany: Donjon Marine Co., LLC / Tallvine North America Marine Infrastructure Platform
result.rationale: Keep the Donjon key but rename/broaden it: Donjon launched Tallvine's platform in 2025; Lind became its second, separately branded operator in 2026. No legal umbrella was disclosed. Tallvine leads; Thoroughbred is the industrial partner and is also named by seller counsel as a buyer. Stakes, fund, vehicle and governance are undisclosed.

identityResolution.canonicalDisplayName: Tallvine North America Marine Infrastructure Platform
identityResolution.boundary: One manager-level proxy for two branded operators; Lind is not proven to be Donjon's legal subsidiary.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: Correct the Donjon record; do not create/merge a separate umbrella.

ownershipResolution.control: Tallvine is lead sponsor. Thoroughbred is the continuing industrial partner; K&L Gates also calls it a buyer, but its economics are undisclosed.
ownershipResolution.sellers: Donjon seller/Witte rollover undisclosed. Kingswood sold Lind and Seneca confirmed its exit; Lind-family rollover undisclosed.

operatingResolution.model: Marine fleet, shipyard, drydock, berth and processing assets supporting dredging, salvage, towing, heavy-lift, remediation, construction, charter and materials services.
operatingResolution.assets: Donjon expressly owns/operates salvage assets and disclosed >70 vessels, >1,000 ft berth, ~4,500 yd3/day processing and an Erie yard with a 1,250-ft drydock and >200,000 sq ft on 44 acres. Lind operates 40 vessels and a Mare Island yard with a 400-ft drydock; title to each Lind asset/site is not public.
operatingResolution.footprint: Donjon: NY/NJ, Northeast, Erie PA and nationwide/global salvage. Lind: SF Bay/Delta, Sacramento/San Joaquin rivers, Vallejo/Mare Island, Petaluma and Collinsville.
operatingResolution.brands: Donjon/John A. Witte Jr. and Lind/Christian Lind remain separate brands and leaders.
operatingResolution.customers: Lind serves industrial, utility, municipal, government and waterfront owners; Donjon serves domestic/international marine customers.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No later sale, recapitalization, signed transfer or pending exit located; both brands remained active.

milestones.detail: Donjon cornerstone; brand/management retained; Thoroughbred partner.
Second platform operator/West Coast expansion; brand/CEO retained; exact close date undisclosed.
